iis_{variant}.short_description: Percentage of adults with {variant.long_name} vaccination in Wisconsin, by county.
iis_{variant}.long_description: Adult immunization coverage rate for {variant.long_name} from the Wisconsin Immunization Registry (WIR). Data are reported annually at the county level.

wi_wir.name: Wisconsin Immunization Registry (WIR)
wi_wir.description: Adult vaccination coverage data from the Wisconsin Immunization Registry (WIR). Includes coverage rates for multiple vaccine types among adults, reported annually at the county level. The WIR is a statewide electronic system that records immunizations given to people of all ages.
wi_wir.restrictions: Public domain. Wisconsin Department of Health Services data is freely available for public use.
